description: Generate formal 4h/10h/20h uint8 Clutter training datasets with seed 42.
notes: Verified 2026-09-04: 3/3 valid published generation manifests, each status=complete and dtype=uint8; NPY/TSV byte sizes match the manifests. Initial failed attempts remain preserved; recovery completed.
Job 61220716 prepares the shared MNIST cache; array 61220717 runs afterok with task mapping 0=4h, 1=10h, 2=20h.
Each generation task uses the exclusive-switch 40h protocol, output_mode=simple, uint8 storage, and NumPy seed 42.
Only training splits are generated because all formal scale experiments use the existing 40h-uint8 validation split.
Each task stages output under /scratch/js3269/stimuli/.clutter_scale_generation and publishes NPY, TSV, then its completion manifest after dtype, shape, and TSV-row validation.
Existing 40h-uint8 data and historical results are not modified.
Initial array 61220717 generated all three complete staged NPY/TSV pairs, then each task failed with exit 127 because git was unavailable on the compute node during provenance capture.
Recovery commit 7fcb173 injects the source commit from the submitter and reuses the retained 61220717 staging leaves without regenerating or deleting failure evidence.
Recovery array 61225664 contains tasks 0-2 and skips the already-completed MNIST preflight.
